title: Samba Variables
description: Samba group: SMB provisioning flags and credentials. Variable names are camelCase and prefixed with the group token 'samba'.

sambaEnabled.description: Set true to enable Samba provisioning for this host.

sambaUsername.description: SMB/Unix account name the samba role provisions. Role default (empty), overridden per variable at run time (-e sambaUsername=...) or per host/group in a downstream inventory. Varies by machine.

sambaPasswordOpItem.description: 1Password item name (within onePasswordVault) whose 'password' field holds the Samba password. Resolved on the super agent by the onepassword role. Role default (empty), overridden per variable or per host/group in a downstream inventory. Varies by machine.

sambaPassword.description: Direct Samba password, resolved at run time and never persisted. Pass via -e to set a password without 1Password; when unset the password is read from 1Password via sambaPasswordOpItem.
